nuggets.text: Several people have claimed to have invented the Wave at the Huskies' home, Husky Stadium, on Halloween 1981.
On Huskies game days, 12,000 or more people can be out on Lake Washington next to the stadium, a practice called sailgating.
The Huskies' stadium hit 133.6 decibels vs. Nebraska in 1992, the highest ever recorded at a college football stadium, per ESPN.
The Huskies' stadium points 18.167 degrees south of due east to keep afternoon sun glare off the players.
Huskies coach Jedd Fisch never played high school or college football; he was an all-state tennis player.
Huskies coach Jedd Fisch went to the University of Florida specifically to work with coach Steve Spurrier.
Huskies QB Demond Williams Jr. was the first Husky to pass for 400 yards and run for 100 in one game, vs. Rutgers in 2025.
Huskies QB Demond Williams Jr. went 6-for-6 for 115 yards and a touchdown in the fourth quarter of the Apple Cup win.
The Huskies have two official mascots: Dubs II and Harry the Husky.
The Huskies hold the FBS record for the longest unbeaten streak: 64 straight games.
